name: Flat 2.5D Scene
description: Flat-shaded 2.5D scenes in perspective: a dark gradient wall, a wooden table receding to the horizon, and objects drawn with a lit face, a shade face and a soft contact shadow (laptops in a row, phones, coin stacks, boxes, books, mugs, monitors, plants). Simple round-headed characters with expressions stand behind the table, and a big yellow stat badge lands on the key number. The headline sweeps from grey to white like karaoke. Warm, friendly, story-driven. No emoji. This is a format (look, camera, motion and layout), not a fixed subject: every video brings new subjects.
prompt_hint: Write 8-12 short scenes (3-5 s each) that tell a small business or money story. title.main is one short line (max ~26 chars) whose words light up as they are read; title.kicker is optional. Build each scene as a set on the table: object (kind laptop, phone, coins with value 1-12 for the stack height, box, books, mug, monitor, plant; count 2-4 for a receding row), character (mood happy, neutral, sad, surprised, thinking, angry; shirt color), and stat for the big number (e.g. +50 %). Use split to put a character next to its coins, or two characters face to face. 1-3 elements per scene. Never use emoji. When the subject is not one of the object kinds, draw it with a drawing element instead of forcing a laptop or a coin stack. Draw new subjects every video: invent the icons, svg sketches and drawing elements for this topic, and never reuse the example spec's scenery, objects or wording.
